look_here_first: Start with the dry-site habit and leaf/stem texture. Julia's goldenrod is a tall perennial of grasslands and open woodlands with gray-green to somewhat hairy foliage and a large terminal panicle of yellow heads.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays — project Hays-local source pool. Travis — UT Plant Resources Center herbarium index includes Solidago juliae. Williamson — dedicated county flora documents S. juliae.

best_field_traits: Central/west Texas grassland and woodland association
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Compared with smoother, wetter-site S. gigantea, S. juliae is a drier-site Central/west Texas species with more visibly hairy/canescent foliage.
